test_name: Stun bar not updating on most junkdog/jungledog variants - 0cbed03e-2aaa-48a5-81aa-e9c855e30563
summary: The stun bar picks its stun source from the nearest game entity above it. On Spiked and Armored dogs, the spikes and armor add a proxy entity on the rib cage or physics rig, so the bar read the proxy's stun, which is always 0. The dog's real buffer kept filling and stunned it. Bloodhound's armor only covers the head, so its bar works. BotHealthBar now skips entities without status effects and reads the dog's own stun buffer, the same way the health bar already does. In the editor, every Spiked and Armored Junkdog and Jungledog bar now binds to the dog itself. The stun line fills after a punch and drains while stunned (seen on screen for Junkdog Spiked, Junkdog Armored and Jungledog Spiked; the rest confirmed by values). Base Junkdog and Bloodhound still work.
instructions:
TASK: some enemies' stun bar is broken - Consistency Test 2

DESCRIPTION:
their stun bar does not change, but after some hits they can get stunned, the singleplayer enemies are:

1. all junkdogs except base junkdog and bloodhound junkdog
2. all jungledogs except normal base

REQUEST (from Amit):
investigate and fix, DO NOT USE /CONVERSATIONS OR ANY OTHER TOOL THAT LETS YOU SEE PREVIOUS CONVERSATIONS AND SOLUTIONS
verified: Before the fix (runtime check): Spiked bar bound to EntityProxy@RibCage, Armored bar to EntityProxy@PhysicsRig, both 0/100, while the root dog had 4.4/50 after a punch

After the fix: BotHealthBar._stunComponent is the root JunkDogEntity on Junkdog Spiked, Armored, Armored Left, Jungledog Spiked, Jungledog Armored Left, base Junkdog, Bloodhound, base Jungledog and Turbo Junkdog

After a 20-damage blunt punch, the stun line fills from the right. Seen on screen for Junkdog Spiked (~1/3), Junkdog Armored (~1/3) and Jungledog Spiked (~1/4), matching root buffers of 17.9/50 and 17.1/70; the other variants have the same root values
80-damage punch: all stunned; Junkdog Armored shows the stun icon and a light-blue line, about two-thirds full and draining
Regression: base Junkdog and Bloodhound are still bound to the root and fill and stun (by value, plus small wide shots)
not_done: Turbo Spiked and Turbo Armored Junkdog and Jungledog were not spawned. They use the same spike/armor proxy path that the fix covers in BotHealthBar.Setup

Plain Turbo Junkdog, Friendly, Rabid and Jingle Ball have no spike or armor proxy. Turbo Junkdog was already bound to the root before the fix. Its stun fills at half rate (turbo) and decays at 30/s, so the line can look static, but it works. Turbo JungleDog could not be spawned: CombatDebug.InstantiateBot('Turbo JungleDog') returned null
Multiplayer bots also use BotHealthBar, but they were not tested
console_errors: PhysicsRig: Does this happen? how did you get a ref to a proxy? probably should not be happening ... (raised by the QA inspection snippet calling isBot on a proxy through the bridge, not by game code)
